title: Inpage Navigation / Compact / Slider
summary: Horizontal slider for compact category nodes with configurable navigation, scrollbar visibility, and optional CTA buttons.
features: Multiple node styles: default, solid, outline with various backgrounds
Auto-hiding navigation when all nodes fit on screen
Optional call-to-action button with variant selection
longDescription:
## Purpose

The InpageNavigationCompactSlider component provides a horizontal slider for displaying compact category nodes, optimized for space-constrained layouts. It combines the efficiency of compact nodes with smooth slider navigation for browsing larger category sets.

## Use Cases

- Display subcategory sliders on product listing page headers
- Create horizontal category navigation in sidebar or filter sections
- Show sale category highlights with dedicated styling variants
- Add promotional flags like "Sale" or "New" to featured categories
- Include optional CTA buttons for directing users to category overviews

## Design Rationale

The slider automatically adapts its navigation visibility: when all nodes fit on screen, controls hide to reduce clutter. Multiple background options (none, light, dark, bright, pale) combined with node variants (default, solid, outline) provide extensive styling flexibility. Navigation position flexibility (top or bottom) allows integration with various page layouts. CTA buttons automatically position navigation to the bottom for balanced visual layout.
